title.zh: 将北伊罗戈省丁格拉斯市镇的Medina-bangay小学改名为Medina-parado小学并作出相应规定的法案
title.en: An Act Renaming the Medina-bangay Elementary School in the Municipality of Dingras, Province of Ilocos Norte, To Medina-parado Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Renaming the Medina-bangay Elementary School in the Municipality of Dingras, Province of Ilocos Norte, To Medina-parado Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường Tiểu học Medina-bangay tại Đô thị Dingras, Tỉnh Ilocos Norte thành Trường Tiểu học Medina-parado
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Medina-bangay ในเทศบาล Dingras จังหวัด Ilocos Norte เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Medina-parado
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Nama Sekolah Dasar Medina-bangay di Kotamadya Dingras, Provinsi Ilocos Norte menjadi Sekolah Dasar Medina-parado
title.ms: Akta Menukar Nama Sekolah Rendah Medina-bangay di Perbandaran Dingras, Wilayah Ilocos Norte kepada Sekolah Rendah Medina-parado

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7501_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Medina-Bangay Elementary School located in the Municipality of Dingras, Province of Ilocos Norte, is hereby renamed as the Medina-Parado Elementary School.
All allocations provided for the operation and maintenance of the Medina-Bangay Elementary School shall be implemented to the Medina-Parado Elementary School.
The complete organizational staff of the Medina-Bangay Elementary School is deemed adopted by the Medina-Parado Elementary School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
